note: The scout agent's new strategies (agents/scout_strategies.py). bots: which bots' agents test it (bot1-bot4 portfolios, bot5/bot6 scalping 1-15 minutes, bot7 economic releases); timeframes: what the source states; markets: fx, index, metal, energy, crypto, stock (empty = all of the bot's).

strategies.name: RV EMA20 cross over the 5m EMA200, 0.5% stop, 1:2, 1-minute
strategies.rules: 1m chart: long when price crosses above EMA20 and close > EMA200 of 5m closes (short mirror) / stop 0.5% from entry / target 2x stop (1%)

strategies.name: Alligator + Fractals breakout, fractal stop, 1:3
strategies.rules: M30/H1/H4: Alligator 13/8/5 (shift 8/5/3) awake up, price above it, close above last up-fractal that does not touch the Alligator (short mirror) / stop at last down-fractal / target 1:3

strategies.name: Pavan CPR: cross above top CPR, stop at pivot, long only
strategies.rules: 1m intraday: previous close below TC=(prevH+prevL)/2 and close above it, long only / stop at pivot (H+L+C)/3 / target 50 points (ours: 0.2% of price)

strategies.name: NFP straddle of the 4-hour pre-release range, target = range
strategies.rules: 5m: 30 min before NFP take 4h high/low, buy stop 5-10 pips above high, sell stop 5-10 pips below low (ours: 1 ATR) / stop = the opposite order / target = entry +/- the range

strategies.name: NFP V-shaped reversal candle after the release, 1:3
strategies.rules: 5m/15m: skip the release spike, enter on a reversal candle (hammer) against the first move / tight stop beyond the recent low (high) / target 1:3

strategies.name: Stochastic Hash 16/7/3 cross at 25/70, 3.18R
strategies.rules: 4H+: slow stoch 16/7/3, long when K crosses up D below 25, short when K crosses down D above 70 / stop 2.2% (ours: 1.2 ATR) / target 7% (3.18R), exit at the opposite extreme

strategies.name: Cowabunga: 4H trend + 15m EMA5/10, RSI9, stoch, MACD, 1R, out 16:00 NY
strategies.rules: 15m with 4H trend: EMA5 crosses EMA10, RSI9>50, stoch(10,3,3) rising not overbought, MACD hist turning up (short mirror) / stop at recent swing low / target round number or same pips as risk (ours 1R), close at 16:00 ET

strategies.name: EMA 5/13 cross + VWAP + ADX>20, stop at the cross, 2R
strategies.rules: 15m: EMA5 crosses EMA13, long above VWAP / short below, ADX>20 / stop at the EMA intersection / target RR 2

strategies.name: Pivot liquidity sweep + momentum candle + EMA200, 1:2
strategies.rules: 15m XAUUSD: break below last pivot low then close back above, momentum candle, above EMA200 (short mirror) / stop slightly beyond the pivot + ATR buffer / target 1:2

strategies.name: Toto SBL: EMA 50/100/200 aligned, swing sweep in killzones, 2R
strategies.rules: 15m London/NY killzones: EMA 50/100/200 aligned, sell-side liquidity sweep then a confirming up close (short mirror) / stop at the sweep level / target 2R

strategies.name: NY first 5m candle break, 1m FVG retest + engulfing, 3R
strategies.rules: 1m: break of the 9:30 ET first 5m candle high with an FVG, price digs into the FVG, engulfing close above the retest body (short mirror) / stop one tick below the dig candles / target 3:1

strategies.name: CPI anchored-VWAP retest after the spike, confirmation candle, 1:2
strategies.rules: CPI, 5m/15m: AVWAP anchored at the release candle, wait 5-10 min, after the spike enter on a pin bar/engulfing at the AVWAP retest against the spike / stop just beyond the spike extreme / target 1:1.5-1:2 (ours 1:2)

strategies.name: Doji sandwich continuation, stop at the doji, stochastic exit
strategies.rules: 4H: large candle, doji, large candle same direction -> enter at the 4th candle open / stop beyond the doji / exit when stochastic overbought (oversold for shorts)

strategies.name: VWAP cross + MACD flip, exit on the MACD cross back, 1-minute
strategies.rules: 1m: close through VWAP with MACD(12,26,9) crossing its signal the same way within 4-5 candles / stop beyond the recent swing / take profit when MACD crosses back

strategies.name: ALMA 21 + Stochastic 21/1/3 cross of 20/80, 1-minute
strategies.rules: 1m: close above ALMA(21,0.85,6) with stoch(21,1,3) crossing above 20 (short: below ALMA, cross below 80) / stop beyond nearest swing / take profit at the opposite stochastic zone

strategies.name: RSI(4) 80/20 + Bollinger touch, target the opposite band, 1-minute
strategies.rules: 1m: RSI(4) back above 20 with price at/through the lower BB(20,2) (short mirror at 80/upper) / stop beyond swing or outside the band / target the opposite band or RSI opposite zone

strategies.name: freqtrade ScalpingSimple: RSI<30 over SMA5, 0.5% stop, 1% target
strategies.rules: 1m long: RSI14<30, close>SMA5, up bar / stoploss -0.5% / ROI 1% (falling to 0.1% by 30 min), exit RSI>70 or SMA5 under SMA10

strategies.name: freqtrade MeanReversionScalper: BB + RSI + volume spike, out at mid band
strategies.rules: 5m long: close<=BB(20,2) lower, RSI14<30, volume>1.5x avg, BB width>0.5%, 1h EMA50 not falling >0.3% / stoploss -0.8% / ROI 0.6%, exit at the middle band

strategies.name: freqtrade RSI_BB: 1-SD lower band long, 3-SD upper band short
strategies.rules: 15m futures: long close<BB(20,1SD) lower; short RSI>56 and close>BB(20,3SD) upper; each exits on the other's signal / stoploss -10% / ROI 85%

strategies.name: DAX false breakout of the 20-bar low + SuperTrend 18/1.5, long
strategies.rules: 15m DAX long: previous bar a new 20-bar low, high under prior 20-bar high, up close, bar range < half the 20-bar range, close above SuperTrend(1.5,18) / stop 80 points (ours 4.5 ATR) / target 150 points (ours 8.4 ATR)

strategies.name: Jump: 16-bar mid +/- 2 ATR stop entry with 60m/30m filters, 5-minute
strategies.rules: 5m NASDAQ: buy stop at mid(16-bar high/low)+2ATR15 if close>close[24], 60m close>SMA300, 30m ADX>=20, not Friday (short mirror, ADX<=20, not Tuesday, low volatility) / stop 8 ATR20 / target 7 ATR20

strategies.name: 5 EMA high/low fade scalp, 8-pip stop, 5-pip target, London/NY open hour
strategies.rules: 5m: candle opens below the 5 EMA (lows) -> buy, opens above the 5 EMA high -> sell, hour after London/NY open / stop 8 pips (ours 1.8 ATR) / target 5 pips (ours 1.1 ATR)

strategies.name: Keltner scalp: SMA89 + MACD 5/34/5 turn + stochastic, 1-minute
strategies.rules: 1m EUR/USD: price above/testing SMA89, inside Keltner(22), MACD(5,34,5) below zero, stoch momentum near -40, MACD turns up through its 5-MA (short mirror) / stop 1 pip outside the channel, max 12 pips / target 6-12 pips

strategies.name: EURUSD 5m TEMA21 vs SMA300 + BB width + CCI -110/160, CCI 210 exit
strategies.rules: 5m 07-22h no weekend: TEMA21>SMA300, BBwidth(50)>0.003, CCI20 crosses over -110 (short: TEMA<SMA, CCI under 160) / stop 25 pips (ours 5.5 ATR) / exit CCI over 210 (short under -210)

strategies.name: Bollinger + RSI 30/70 + Stochastic 5/3/3 scalp, mid-band exit, 5-minute
strategies.rules: 5m: below lower BB(20,2) + RSI14<30 + stoch(5,3,3)<20 -> buy at the close (short mirror 70/80) / stop 10 pips beyond the candle (ours 2.2 ATR) / target 20 pips (ours 4.4 ATR), or out on a close past the middle band

strategies.name: Admiral Keltner 50/10/2.75 re-entry + Stochastic 14/7/3, target the middle, M15
strategies.rules: M15: candle pierces a Keltner band (50,10,2.75/3.75) and closes back inside, stochastic(14,7,3) crossing up away from 80 (short mirror) / stop 8 pips + spread beyond the candle (ours 1.1 ATR) / target the middle line, min 10 pips (ours 1.4 ATR)

strategies.name: Meta Scalper: Bollinger touch and retrace, half-width stop, 5% width target
strategies.rules: M1/M5: bar touches the lower Bollinger band (~95% envelope) and the next bar retraces inside -> buy (short mirror) / stop <= half the band width / target ~5% of the band width

strategies.name: DAX first 5-minute bar direction at 09:05, 5/10 points, flat 17:30
strategies.rules: 5m DAX: the 09:00-09:05 bar closes >1 point above its open -> buy at 09:05, otherwise sell / stop 5 points (ours 0.6 ATR) / target 10 points (ours 1.25 ATR), flat 17:30

strategies.name: Hull Suite 55 + DI cross, swing stop, 1:1, 1-minute
strategies.rules: 1m: +DI crosses above -DI while the Hull Suite is green -> buy (mirror) / stop slightly beyond the recent swing / target 1:1 (1-1.5x the stop)

strategies.name: Alpha S/R: engulfing inside the 15m EMA36 channel, channel stop, 1:3, gold 5m
strategies.rules: 5m XAUUSD: open inside the 15m EMA36 +/-0.175% channel, bullish engulfing, above 5m/15m EMAs, RSI<=70, BB width>=0.002, squeeze<0 (short mirror) / stop channel band - $0.50 / target 1:3, out 17:00 NY, no Friday

strategies.name: freqtrade EMA_RSIStrategy: 1h trend + EMA20/50 + RSI 40-70 + ADX, -7%/4.5%
strategies.rules: 5m long: 1h EMA50>=0.995xEMA200, EMA20>EMA50, close>EMA50, 40<RSI<70, ADX>18, volume>0.8x avg / stoploss -7% / ROI 4.5% falling to 0 at 360 min; exit on trend/EMA/RSI<35 failure

strategies.name: London 08:15 GMT side of the central pivot, stop past the pivot, target R2/S2
strategies.rules: 15m EUR/USD: London open 08:00 GMT, after the first 15 minutes buy if above the central pivot (sell below) / stop 5-10 pips past the pivot (ours 1 ATR) / TP1 R1, TP2 R2 (ours R2/S2)

strategies.name: Crypto 1H: EMA50 trend + EMA21 touch, 5-bar stop, 24-bar target, min 2R
strategies.rules: 1H: price above rising EMA50, touch of EMA21, signal candle (body>=0.15%) within 3 bars, London/NY (short mirror) / stop 5-bar low - ATR buffer / target 24-bar high, only if >= 2R

strategies.name: ATR Trend + RSI<40 pullback over a rising EMA200, 1.5/3 ATR, long
strategies.rules: 15m/30m/1H long: price above a rising EMA200, RSI dips under 40, ATR above a minimum / stop 1.5 ATR / target 3 ATR, optional exit RSI>70

strategies.name: EMA 50/100 cross + pullback + Stochastic 20/80, swing stop, 10-pip target, 1-minute
strategies.rules: 1m EUR/USD, GBP/USD: EMA50 crossed above EMA100, pullback to the EMAs, stochastic rises above 20 (short: EMA50<EMA100, stoch falls below 80) / stop beyond the latest swing / target 8-12 pips (ours 6.5 ATR)

strategies.name: Gold 5m: 4H EMA200 trend, EMA50 pullback + engulfing/hammer + RSI 40, 2R, 13-17 GMT
strategies.rules: 5m XAUUSD: above 4H EMA200, pullback to EMA50, hammer/engulfing, RSI back above 40, MACD cross - at least 3 confirmations, 13-17 GMT (short mirror) / stop 5-10 pips beyond the swing (ours 0.2 ATR) / target >= 2:1

strategies.name: Butterfly harmonic X-A-B-C-D, entry at the 1.27 XA extension, target A
strategies.source: Facebook (Trader Dhana reel, sent by the user)
strategies.rules: 15m/30m intraday: AB=0.786 XA, BC=0.382-0.886 AB, CD=1.618-2.24 BC, D=1.27 XA extension beyond X; bearish X high -> sell at D (bullish mirror) / stop a little beyond D (ours 1.414 XA) / target the A level

strategies.name: Butterfly harmonic, target 0.618 of AD (user's variant)
strategies.source: Facebook (Trader Dhana reel, sent by the user)
strategies.rules: as SC037 / stop 1.414 XA / target the 0.618 retracement of AD (alternative target the user asked to test)

strategies.name: Trendline break + Fibonacci 0.5-0.618 entry, stop under 0.618, impulse-length target
strategies.source: Facebook (Trade Master reel 'Beginner to pro day 26', sent by the user)
strategies.rules: uptrend with BOS + rising trendline under the lows; close breaks the line; Fib of the whole impulse (low=1, high=0); buy in 0.5-0.618 (bearish mirror) / stop a little under 0.618 / target = impulse length projected from the entry; timeframe not stated - user: test 15m-4H

strategies.name: Trendline break + Fibonacci 0.5-0.618, stop under 0.786, target the impulse high (user's variant)
strategies.source: Facebook (Trade Master reel, sent by the user)
strategies.rules: as SC039 / stop under 0.786 / target the previous high (0) - the alternatives the user asked to test

strategies.name: Fluid Money: Asian-session high/low break in its last quarter, 0.6/1.0 ATR, 15m
strategies.rules: 15m only / in the last quarter of the Asian box, break of the session high (buy) or low (sell) / stop 5-7 pips (ours 0.6 ATR) / target max 20 pips, 10 recommended (ours 1.0 ATR)

strategies.name: EMA 9/21 cross + RSI 50-70 filter, swing stop, 2R
strategies.rules: 5m/15m / EMA9 crosses EMA21 with RSI14 50-70 (long) or under 50 (short) / stop beyond the recent swing / target 2:1 (1.5:1 also named)

strategies.name: 15MDbleBol: BB 20 + BB 25 poke, reversal candle back inside, target the middle band
strategies.rules: 15M (also 30M-D) / BB20 + BB25: a candle pokes outside, a reversal candle closes past the previous body and back inside / stop beyond the outermost wick / target the middle band

strategies.name: RSI 30/70 re-cross with a reversal bar, half at 0.5R + break-even, RSI exit
strategies.rules: daily (example 4H) / RSI back above 30 on a bullish bar (below 70 on a bearish bar) / stop several pips beyond the swing / half out at 0.5R, rest to break-even, out on RSI 70 back-cross (short: RSI oversold)

strategies.name: RSI(3) + Full Stochastic 6/3/3 cross over/under SMA150, exit at the opposite extreme
strategies.rules: daily best (example 1H) / above SMA150, RSI3 oversold, Full Stoch 6/3/3 bullish cross while oversold (mirror) / stop 5-10 pips beyond the swing / exit when the Stochastic reaches the opposite extreme

strategies.name: Supertrend 10/3 + Stochastic RSI cross from 20/80, stop at the line, 2R
strategies.rules: daily swing, 15m day variant / Supertrend 10/3 below the close + StochRSI 14,14,3,3 %K crosses %D from <=20 (mirror from >=80) / stop at the Supertrend value / target 2R; out on a flip or a cross back

strategies.name: 1-minute VWAP + EMA 9/21 pullback-bar break, 1.5R or VWAP exit
strategies.rules: 1m with 5m bias / 5m close above VWAP, EMA9 > EMA21, pullback to EMA9 without a close under VWAP, buy the break of the pullback bar's high / stop at the pullback low, skip if > 0.3% / target 1.5R or a 1m close back through VWAP; flat before the close

strategies.name: SuperTrade ST1: Supertrend flip above EMA200, 1 ATR stop, 4 ATR target, long
strategies.rules: any, 1H/4H/D more reliable / long only: Supertrend flips bullish, close above the line and above EMA200 / stop 1 ATR / target 4 ATR

strategies.name: ETH Signal: Supertrend 12/2.76 + RSI 12, 4 ATR stop, 2 / 2.237 ATR target, 15m
strategies.rules: 15m ETHUSDT / Supertrend 12/2.76 buy with RSI12 < 70 (sell with RSI > 30) / stop 4 x ATR12 / target 2 x ATR12 long, 2.237 x ATR12 short

strategies.name: EMA50 + MACD histogram + RSI 50-70 / 30-50, 1 ATR stop, 2 ATR target, 15m
strategies.rules: 15m / above EMA50 + MACD histogram > 0 + RSI 50-70 (mirror below, RSI 30-50) / stop 1 ATR / target 2 ATR

strategies.name: Engulfing / hammer + same-bar MACD cross, 1.5 ATR stop, 2 ATR target, 15m
strategies.rules: 15m / bullish engulfing or hammer + MACD 12/26/9 cross up on the same bar (mirror: bearish engulfing / shooting star + cross down) / stop 1.5 x ATR14 / target 2 x ATR14

strategies.name: Three-Step 9:30 range: 5m-candle range, 1m FVG break, first-close stop, 2R
strategies.rules: 1m, 9:30-10:30 NY / range = first 5m candle after 9:30; FVG with a candle closing outside the range (BREAK) / stop at the first candle that closed outside / target 2:1

strategies.name: Macketings 1m: EMA 80/90 band over 340/500 + SMA325, 0.2% stop, 2.5% target
strategies.rules: 1m / EMA 80/90 over 340/500, EMA340 > EMA500, above SMA325; retest of the 80/90 band then a breakout / stop 0.2% / target 2.5%; at 0.3% profit lock 0.2%; out on EMA 80/90 x 340 or 340 x 500

strategies.name: CCI + EMA10 crossing EMA21/50, 12-point stop, 2.5R, M5+
strategies.rules: M5 and higher / EMA10 crosses up through EMA21 and EMA50 with CCI > 0 (mirror) / stop 10-15 points or behind the nearest pivot (ours 2.5 ATR) / target 2-3 x the stop (ours 2.5R)

strategies.name: EMA21 + CCI20 zero agreement, swing stop, exit on the cross back, 15m
strategies.rules: daily, 15m day variant / close above EMA21 and CCI20 >= 0 (the second becoming true) (mirror) / stop beyond the pullback swing / out on a close back through EMA21 or CCI back through 0, or the session close

strategies.name: CCI12 > 80 & RSI15 > 75 two bars (CCI < -95 & RSI < 30), 125/60 pips, 1H
strategies.rules: 1H / CCI12 > 80 and RSI15 > 75 on two closed candles -> long; CCI < -95 and RSI < 30 -> short / stop 125 pips (ours 10 ATR) / target 60 pips (ours 5 ATR)

strategies.name: M15 EMA20/50 pullback + RSI 50 + engulfing / pin bar, swing stop, 2R, London-NY
strategies.rules: M15, London/NY / above EMA20 and EMA50, pullback to EMA20, RSI > 50, bullish engulfing or pin bar (mirror) / stop 2-3 pips beyond the swing / target next S/R, 1:1.5-1:2 (ours 2R)

strategies.name: NY 09:30-10:00 range breakout, half at 2R + break-even, rest 3R, one a day
strategies.rules: M1/M5/M15 / break of the 09:30-10:00 NY range high (long) or low (short), one trade a day / stop at the opposite side / half at 2R with the rest to break-even, rest at 3R

strategies.name: Bollinger middle + MACD signal state, 3-bar stop, exit when either flips, 5m
strategies.rules: daily, 5m day variant / first close above the BB20 middle with MACD above its signal (mirror) / stop at the 3-bar low, skip if wider than the mid-to-upper gap / out when either condition flips, or the session close

strategies.name: BTC 15m: rising SMA200, SMA5 crosses the BB 21 midline, fractal stop, out under the midline
strategies.rules: 15m / above a rising SMA200, SMA5 crosses above the BB midline (21), bullish candle; long only / stop on the fractal below / out on a close under the 21 MA

strategies.name: Gold 1h: under the BB(15) top and over the 53-bar high, 2.9 / 5.8 ATR(9), long
strategies.rules: 1h / long only: close under the upper BB(15) and above the 53-bar high / stop 2.9 x ATR9 / target 5.8 x ATR9

strategies.name: XAU 55-MA high/low channel break + Heikin-Ashi colour, previous-candle stop, 1.5R
strategies.rules: M1/M5 / break above the 55-MA of highs with a green Heikin-Ashi candle (below the 55-MA of lows with a red one) / stop beyond the previous candle / target 1:1.5

strategies.name: ES 5-minute ORB, stop the other edge, target half the range, range <= 0.55%, no Tuesdays
strategies.rules: 5m range 09:30-09:35 ET on ES / break above (long) or below (short), skip ranges > 0.55% and Tuesdays / stop at the opposite edge / target 50% of the range beyond the breakout
